newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Constran to resolve Brazil debt first - paper.
newsitem.headline: Constran to resolve Brazil debt first - paper.

text.p: Constran International Ltd, the Cayman Island's unit of Brazil's Grupo Itamarati, which defaulted on a $13 million Euro-commercial paper payment this week, will not repay foreign creditors until Grupo Itamarati resolves its debt with Brazilian banks, O Globo newspaper reported.

Olacyr de Moraes, president of Grupo Itamarati, told O Globo that Constran's $13 million payment and two upcoming commercial paper payments in December and February, totalling $42 million, would not be paid util the group resolved its debt with Brazilian banks.
"We don't want to privilege any creditor. Our objective is to obtain a single solution," Moraes was quoted as saying.
Brazilian investment bank Bozano Simonsen is helping Grupo Itamarati renegotiate its debt, including a $1 billion obligation to state development bank BNDES.
Constran Ltd's debt is guaranteed by Grupo Itamarati and its Brazilian unit Constran S.A. Construcoes e Comercio.
Officials at Bozano, Simonsen, Constran S.A. and Grupo Itamarati would not comment on the report.
